csv_project_name: CMAR for Baseball and Softball Fields Upgrades
csv_scope_of_work: The Liberty Center Local School District Board of Education ( Owner ) is seeking construction manager at-risk services for upgrades to its baseball and softball fields. The Project consists of renovation of the infield surfaces and areas surrounding the fields, removal of the current playing material and surface, removal of current grass areas and replacement of sod, rebuilding of mounds and batting box areas, and installation of an irrigation system in the infield, foul territory, and outfield of the baseball field.
